The ATC hierarchy is populated and serves as the KG's representation of bronchodilator mechanism classes. I'll map bronchodilator ingredients to their ATC mechanism class, then count active prescriptions in the COPD cohort.

Let me build this in one query. Bronchodilator mechanism classes in ATC R03 are: selective beta-2 adrenergic agonists (R03AC/R03CC), anticholinergics/muscarinic antagonists (R03BB), and xanthines/PDE inhibitors (R03DA). I'll define the COPD cohort as persons with a COPD condition, and "active prescriptions" as drug_exposures whose end date is on/after today (2026-07-27) or ongoing.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name
FROM omop.concept c
WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'ATC' AND c.concept_class_id = 'ATC 4th'
AND c.concept_id IN (
  SELECT ca.ancestor_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
) 
AND (c.concept_name LIKE '%Selective beta-2-adrenoreceptor agonists%'
     OR c.concept_name LIKE '%Anticholinergics%'
     OR c.concept_name LIKE '%Xanthines%'
     OR c.concept_name LIKE '%Adrenergics and other drugs for obstructive%')

I'll focus the R03 bronchodilator classes properly and run the cohort counts. Let me get the canonical R03 mechanism subtree and count active COPD-cohort prescriptions per class in one query.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH copd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 255573   -- SNOMED "Chronic obstructive lung disease"
),
moa AS (
  SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name AS moa_class
  FROM omop.concept c
  WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'ATC' AND c.concept_class_id = 'ATC 4th'
    AND c.concept_name IN (
      'Selective beta-2-adrenoreceptor agonists',
      'Anticholinergics',
      'Xanthines',
      'Adrenergics and other drugs for obstructive airway diseases'
    )
),
bronch_ingredients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, moa.moa_class
  FROM moa
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON moa.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT bi.moa_class,
       COUNT(*) AS n_active_rx,
       COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS n_patients
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN copd ON de.person_id = copd.person_id
JOIN bronch_ingredients bi ON de.drug_concept_id = bi.drug_concept_id
WHERE (de.drug_exposure_end_date IS NULL OR de.drug_exposure_end_date >= '2026-07-27')
GROUP BY bi.moa_class
ORDER BY n_active_rx DESC

),
moa AS (

  FROM omop.concept c
  WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'ATC' AND c.concept_class_id = 'ATC 4th'
    AND c.concept_name IN (
      'Selective beta-2-adrenoreceptor agonists',

      'Adrenergics and other drugs for obstructive airway diseases')
),
bronch AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, moa.moa_class
  FROM moa JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON moa.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT b.moa_class,
       COUNT(*) AS n_rx_alltime,
       SUM(CASE WHEN de.drug_exposure_end_date IS NULL OR de.drug_exposure_end_date >= '2026-07-27' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_active_rx,
       COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS n_patients_alltime
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN copd ON de.person_id = copd.person_id
JOIN bronch b ON de.drug_concept_id = b.drug_concept_id
GROUP BY b.moa_class
ORDER BY n_active_rx DESC

Confirmed: Xanthines and the "Adrenergics and other drugs for obstructive airway diseases" classes have zero active prescriptions in the COPD cohort. So only two bronchodilator mechanisms are represented.

## Answer

Using the medcp KG, bronchodilator mechanism classes are represented through the ATC R03 hierarchy (the `Has MoA`/NDF-RT mechanism edges are empty in this instance, so ATC 4th-level classes serve as the mechanism grouping). Mapping bronchodilator ingredients to their mechanism class and counting **active** prescriptions (drug exposures ongoing as of 2026-07-27) in the COPD cohort (persons with SNOMED *Chronic obstructive lung disease*, concept 255573):

| Bronchodilator mechanism | Active Rx | Patients |
|---|---|---|
| Selective β2-adrenoceptor agonists | 22 | 22 |
| Anticholinergics (muscarinic antagonists) | 18 | 18 |
| Xanthines (PDE inhibitors) | 0 | 0 |
| Adrenergics + other (combinations) | 0 | 0 |

**Most represented:** selective β2-adrenoceptor agonists (22 active prescriptions), followed closely by anticholinergics/muscarinic antagonists (18). Xanthine (PDE-inhibitor) and combination-adrenergic mechanisms are not present in active prescriptions.
